themes.label: Provide Education and Training
themes.definition: Clients request more training, education, or detailed explanations to understand how the insurance works, its benefits, and how to make claims.
themes.example_quote: If they educate me more on how the insurance works

themes.label: Speed Up Claim Payouts
themes.definition: Clients request that insurance claims be processed and paid out much faster, without long delays or unfulfilled promises.
themes.example_quote: Your service is good, but the problem is that compensation takes too long.

themes.label: Expand Coverage to Family Members
themes.definition: Clients request that the insurance policy be extended to cover family members, such as spouses and children, instead of only covering the individual group member.
themes.example_quote: It could be better if this insurance supported even our children and spouses.

themes.label: Simplify Claim Process and Requirements
themes.definition: Clients request a simpler, more accessible claim process, including reducing the burden of collecting hospital documents or relaxing strict ID requirements.

themes.label: Increase Product Awareness and Advertising
themes.definition: Clients suggest increasing advertising, holding physical meetings, or proactively informing clients about their coverage so they are aware the product exists.
themes.example_quote: IT MUST IMPRVE IN ADVERTIZING THE PRODUCT BECAUSE I WAS SICK AND I DIDNT KNOW THAT I WAS COVERED

themes.label: Increase Payout Amounts and Benefits
themes.definition: Clients request higher payout amounts to cover actual medical costs, or suggest introducing refunds or benefits for members who do not make claims.
themes.example_quote: We kindly request an increase in the reimbursement amounts, as there are cases where patients face high hospital costs while lacking sufficient financial capacity

themes.label: Premium Cost Hard to Justify
themes.definition: Clients feel the premium they pay is too high, difficult to afford, or hard to justify relative to the perceived benefit, distinct from wanting bigger claim payouts.
themes.example_quote: the cost of maintaining the insurance feels difficult to justify, especially when the benefits are not clearly visible or immediately impactful
